questions.stem: A reaction that is spontaneous as written ________.
questions.stemZh: 按书写方向自发的反应 ________。

options.text: is also spontaneous in the reverse direction
has an equilibrium position that lies far to the left

optionsZh.B: 无需外界干预即可进行

questions.explanation: 自发（as written）指不需外界干预即可进行；与快慢无关。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: When a system is at equilibrium, ________.
questions.stemZh: 当系统处于平衡时，________。

options.text: the reverse process is spontaneous but the forward process is not
the forward and the reverse processes are both spontaneous
the forward process is spontaneous but the reverse process is not
the process is not spontaneous in either direction
both forward and reverse processes have stopped

optionsZh.A: 逆过程自发但正过程不自发
optionsZh.C: 正过程自发但逆过程不自发

questions.explanation: 平衡时 ΔG=0，正、逆方向都没有净自发倾向（E 错在“停止”，平衡是动态的）。【A 与 D 口径易混，标待核】

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: A reversible process is one that ________.
questions.stemZh: 可逆过程是 ________ 的过程。

options.text: can be reversed with no net change in either system or surroundings
must be carried out at low temperature
must be carried out at high temperature

optionsZh.A: 反转后系统与环境都无净变化

questions.explanation: 可逆过程：反转后系统与环境都不留净变化。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true?
questions.stemZh: 下列说法哪个正确？

options.text: Processes that are spontaneous in one direction are spontaneous in the opposite direction.
Processes are spontaneous because they occur at an observable rate.
Spontaneity can depend on the temperature.
All of the statements are true.

optionsZh.A: 一个方向自发的过程其反方向也自发
optionsZh.B: 过程自发是因为以可观测速率发生

questions.explanation: 自发性可随温度改变（ΔG=ΔH−TΔS）；与反应速率无关。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: The thermodynamic quantity that expresses the extent of randomness in a system is ________.
questions.stemZh: 表示系统无序程度的热力学量是 ________。
questions.explanation: 熵（entropy）衡量系统无序/混乱程度。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: The entropy of the universe is ________.

options.text: the same as the energy, E

questions.explanation: 宇宙的熵不断增大（第二定律）。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: The second law of thermodynamics states that ________.
questions.stemZh: 热力学第二定律指出 ________。

options.text: for any spontaneous process, the entropy of the universe increases
the entropy of a pure crystalline substance is zero at absolute zero

optionsZh.C: 任何自发过程宇宙熵增大
optionsZh.D: 纯晶体在绝对零度熵为零

questions.explanation: 第二定律：任何自发过程使宇宙总熵增大。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Which one of the following processes produces a decrease of the entropy of the system?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个过程使系统熵减小？
questions.explanation: 氧气溶于水是气→溶液，混乱度减小，系统熵减小；其余均增大。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Consider a pure crystalline solid that is heated from absolute zero to a temperature above the boiling point of the liquid. Which of the following processes produces the greatest increase in the entropy of the substance?
questions.stemZh: 将纯晶体固从绝对零度加热到高于该液体沸点的温度。下列哪个过程使物质熵增最大？
questions.explanation: 液→气（汽化）的相变熵增最大。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: ΔS is positive for the reaction ________.
questions.stemZh: 反应 ________ 的 ΔS 为正。
questions.explanation: 2SO3→2SO2+O2 气体分子数由2增到3，ΔS>0。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Which reaction produces a decrease in the entropy of the system?
questions.stemZh: 哪个反应使系统熵减小？
questions.explanation: 2H2(g)+O2(g)→2H2O(l)：气体减少且生成液体，熵减小。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Which reaction produces an increase in the entropy of the system?
questions.stemZh: 哪个反应使系统熵增大？
questions.explanation: CO2(s)→CO2(g) 由固变气，熵增大。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: The equilibrium position corresponds to which letter on the graph of G vs. f (course of reaction) below? 
questions.stemZh: 在下图 G 对反应进程(f) 的图中，平衡位置对应哪个字母？
questions.explanation: 图 G–反应进程的最低点 C 即平衡位置。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: For the reaction C2H6 (g) → C2H4 (g) + H2 (g) ΔH° is +137 kJ/mol and ΔS° is +120 J/K ∙ mol. This reaction is ________.
questions.stemZh: 反应 C2H6(g)→C2H4(g)+H2(g) 的 ΔH°=+137 kJ/mol，ΔS°=+120 J/K·mol。该反应 ________。
questions.explanation: ΔH>0、ΔS>0，高温自发：T>ΔH/ΔS=137000/120≈1142 K，故仅高温自发。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: For the reaction 2 C4H10 (g) + 13 O2 (g) → 8 CO2 (g) + 10 H2O (g) ΔH° is -125 kJ/mol and ΔS° is +253 J/K ∙ mol. This reaction is ________.

options.text: unable to determine without more information

questions.explanation: ΔH<0、ΔS>0 → ΔG<0 对所有温度都自发。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: A reaction that is not spontaneous at low temperature can become spontaneous at high temperature if ΔH is ________ and ΔS is ________.
questions.stemZh: 低温非自发、高温自发，需要 ΔH 为 ________、ΔS 为 ________。
questions.explanation: 低温非自发、高温自发需 ΔH>0、ΔS>0（T 高时 −TΔS 更负）。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Given the following table of thermodynamic data,  complete the following sentence. The vaporization of TiCl4 is ________.
questions.stemZh: 已知下表热力学数据，完成句子：TiCl4 的汽化 ________。（表：TiCl4(g) ΔHf=−763.2, S=354.9；TiCl4(l) ΔHf=−804.2, S=221.9）

options.text: spontaneous at low temperature and nonspontaneous at high temperature
nonspontaneous at low temperature and spontaneous at high temperature
not enough information given to draw a conclusion

questions.explanation: TiCl4(l)→TiCl4(g)：ΔH=ΔHf(g)−ΔHf(l)=−763.2−(−804.2)=+41.0 kJ；ΔS=354.9−221.9=+133.0 J/K。ΔG=ΔH−TΔS，低温>0、高温<0（阈值≈308 K），故低温非自发、高温自发。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: With thermodynamics, one cannot determine ________.
questions.stemZh: 用热力学无法确定 ________。

options.text: the direction of a spontaneous reaction
the value of the equilibrium constant
the temperature at which a reaction will be spontaneous

questions.explanation: 热力学只能判断方向、程度、平衡常数与自发温度，不能判断反应速率（速度）。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Which one of the following statements is true about the equilibrium constant for a reaction if ΔG° for the reaction is negative?
questions.stemZh: 若反应的 ΔG° 为负，关于其平衡常数，下列哪项正确？
questions.explanation: ΔG°=−RT lnK，ΔG°<0 → lnK>0 → K>1。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Which one of the following processes produces a decrease in the entropy of the system?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个过程使系统熵减小？

options.text: evaporation of liquid ethanol into gaseous ethanol
mixing of two gases into one container

optionsZh.E: 两种气体混合到同一容器

questions.explanation: Fe(l)→Fe(s) 凝固，液→固熵减小；其余均熵增。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Of the following, the entropy of ________ is the largest.
questions.stemZh: 下列中，________ 的熵最大。
questions.explanation: 官方答案 A（B2F4(g)）。同为气体时熵随摩尔质量/结构复杂度增大，B2F4 最大。本次AI曾选 C，按官方更正为 A。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: The standard Gibbs free energy of formation of ________ is zero. (a) H2O (l) (b) Fe (s) (c) I2 (s)
questions.stemZh: ________ 的标准生成吉布斯自由能为零。(a) H2O(l) (b) Fe(s) (c) I2(s)

glossary.term: standard Gibbs free energy of formation
glossary.meaning: 标准生成吉布斯自由能

questions.explanation: 标准态单质的 ΔGf°=0：Fe(s)、I2(s) 是；(a) H2O(l) 是化合物，不为零。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: Given the thermodynamic data in the table below, calculate the equilibrium constant (at 298 K) for the reaction: 2 SO2 (g) + O2 (g)  2 SO3 (g) 
questions.stemZh: 根据下表数据，计算反应 2SO2(g)+O2(g)→2SO3(g) 在 298 K 的平衡常数。

questions.label: chapter1c
questions.stem: For a given reaction, ΔH = +22.2 kJ/mol and ΔS = +81.1 J/K-mol. The reaction is spontaneous ________. Assume that ΔH and ΔS do not vary with temperature.
questions.stemZh: 某反应 ΔH=+22.2 kJ/mol，ΔS=+81.1 J/K·mol。该反应在 ________ 自发（设 ΔH、ΔS 不随温度变化）。
questions.explanation: 自发需 ΔG=ΔH−TΔS<0 → T>ΔH/ΔS=22200/81.1≈274 K，即 T>274 K。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: When a hydrocarbon burns in air, what component of air reacts?
questions.explanation: 烃在空气中燃烧，参与反应的是氧气。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Of the reactions below, which one is a decomposition reaction?
questions.explanation: NH4Cl → NH3 + HCl 是分解反应。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which one of the following substances is the product of this combination reaction? Al (s) + I2 (s) → ________
questions.explanation: Al 为 +3、I 为 -1，产物为 AlI3。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which of the following are combustion reactions? 1) CH4 (g) + O2 (g) → CO2 (g) + H2O (l) 2) CaO (s) + CO2 (g) → CaCO3 (s) 3) PbCO3 (s) → PbO (s) + CO2 (g) 4) CH3OH (l) + O2 (g) → CO2 (g) + H2O (l)
questions.explanation: 燃烧反应是 1 和 4。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which of the following are decomposition reactions? 1) CH4 (g) + O2 (g) → CO2 (g) + H2O (l) 2) CaO (s) + CO2 (g) → CaCO3 (s) 3) Mg (s) + O2 (g) → MgO (s) 4) PbCO3 (s) → PbO (s) + CO2 (g)
questions.explanation: 只有 PbCO3 分解是分解反应。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The formula of nitrobenzene is C6H5NO2. The molecular weight of this compound is ________ amu.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The formula weight of silver chromate (Ag2CrO4) is ________ amu.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The molecular weight of the acetic acid (CH3CO2H), rounded to the nearest integer, is ________ amu.
questions.explanation: 乙酸分子量约 60。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The formula weight of a substance is ________.

options.text: the same as the percent by mass weight
the sum of the atomic weights of each atom in its chemical formula
the weight of a sample of the substance

questions.explanation: 式量是化学式中各原子原子量之和。

questions.stem: One mole of ________ contains the largest number of atoms.
questions.explanation: 每摩尔原子数最多的是 C10H8（18 个原子）。

questions.stem: A sulfur oxide is 50.0% by mass sulfur. This molecular formula could be ________.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: When the following equation is balanced, the coefficients are ________. Al(NO3)3 + Na2S → Al2S3 + NaNO3
questions.explanation: 2Al(NO3)3+3Na2S→Al2S3+6NaNO3，系数 2,3,1,6。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: When the following equation is balanced, the coefficient of H2 is ________. K (s) + H2O (l) → KOH (aq) + H2 (g)
questions.explanation: 2K+2H2O→2KOH+H2，H2 系数 1。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: When the following equation is balanced, the coefficient of H2O is ________. Ca (s) + H2O (l) → Ca(OH)2 (aq) + H2 (g)
questions.explanation: Ca+2H2O→Ca(OH)2+H2，H2O 系数 2。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Write the balanced equation for the reaction that occurs when methanol, CH3OH (l), is burned in air. What is the coefficient of methanol in the balanced equation?
questions.explanation: 2CH3OH+3O2→2CO2+4H2O，甲醇系数 2。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: What is the empirical formula of a compound that contains 27.0% S, 13.4% O, and 59.6% Cl by mass?
questions.explanation: S:O:Cl=1:1:2，故为 SOCl2。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A compound contains 38.7% K, 13.9% N, and 47.4% O by mass. What is the empirical formula of the compound?
questions.explanation: K:N:O=1:1:3，故为 KNO3。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Combustion of a 0.9827-g sample of a compound containing only carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen produced 1.900 g of CO2 and 1.070 g of H2O. What is the empirical formula of the compound?
questions.explanation: 由燃烧数据得 C:H:O=4:11:2，即 C4H11O2。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The combustion of propane (C3H8) in the presence of excess oxygen yields CO2 and H2O: C3H8 (g) + 5O2 (g) → 3CO2 (g) + 4H2O (g) When 2.5 mol of O2 are consumed in their reaction, ________ mol of CO2 are produced.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Under appropriate conditions, nitrogen and hydrogen undergo a combination reaction to yield ammonia: N2 (g) + 3H2 (g) → 2NH3 (g) A ________ g sample of N2 requires 3.0 g of H2 for complete reaction.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: If the reaction yield is 94.4%, what mass in grams of hydrogen is produced by the reaction of 4.73 g of magnesium with 1.83 g of water? Mg (s) + 2H2O (l) → Mg(OH)2 (s) + H2 (g)

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The dissolution of water in octane (C8H18) is prevented by ________.

options.text: London dispersion forces between octane molecules
ion-dipole attraction between water and octane molecules
repulsion between like-charged water and octane molecules

questions.explanation: 水分子间氢键阻止其溶于辛烷。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: When argon is placed in a container of neon, the argon spontaneously disperses throughout the neon because ________.

options.text: of the large attractive forces between argon and neon atoms
a decrease in energy occurs when the two mix
the dispersion of argon atoms produces an increase in disorder

questions.explanation: 氩扩散使无序度增大（熵增）。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Hydration is a specific example of the phenomenon known generally as ________.
questions.explanation: 水合是溶剂化的特例。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: When solutions of strong electrolytes in water are formed, the ions are surrounded by water molecules. These interactions are described as a case of ________.
questions.explanation: 离子被水分子包围即水合作用。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: In a saturated solution of a salt in water, ________.

options.text: the rate of crystallization  >  the rate of dissolution
the rate of dissolution  >  the rate of crystallization
seed crystal addition may cause massive crystallization
the rate of crystallization  =  the rate of dissolution
addition of more water causes massive crystallization

questions.explanation: 饱和时溶解速率=结晶速率。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: An unsaturated solution is one that ________.

options.text: contains the maximum concentration of solute possible, and is in equilibrium with undissolved solute
has a concentration lower than the solubility
contains more dissolved solute than the solubility allows

questions.explanation: 不饱和溶液浓度低于溶解度。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A solution with a concentration higher than the solubility is ________.
questions.explanation: 浓度高于溶解度即过饱和。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The principal reason for the extremely low solubility of NaCl in benzene (C6H6) is the ________.

options.text: strength of the covalent bond in NaCl
weak solvation of Na+ and Cl- by C6H6
increased disorder due to mixing of solute and solvent

questions.explanation: 苯对 Na+、Cl- 的溶剂化作用弱，故 NaCl 难溶。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which one of the following is least soluble in water?
questions.explanation: 碳链最长（戊醇）最不溶于水。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which one of the following is most soluble in water?
questions.explanation: 甲醇碳链最短，最易溶于水。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The solubility of nitrogen gas at 25 °C and 1 atm is 6.8 × 10-4 mol/L. If the partial pressure of nitrogen gas in air is 0.76 atm, what is the concentration (molarity) of dissolved nitrogen?

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The concentration of CO2 in a soft drink bottled with a partial pressure of CO2 of 6.5 atm over the liquid at 29 °C is 2.2 × 10-1 M. The Henry's law constant for CO2 at this temperature is ________.

options.text: More information is needed to solve the problem.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Pressure has an appreciable effect on the solubility of ________ in liquids.
questions.explanation: 压强主要影响气体在液体中的溶解度。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which of the following statements is false?

options.text: Nonpolar liquids tend to be insoluble in polar liquids.
The weaker the attraction between the solute and solvent molecules, the greater the solubility.
Substances with similar intermolecular attractive forces tend to be soluble in one another.
The solubility of a gas increases in direct proportion to its partial pressure above the solution.
The solubility of gases in water decreases with increasing temperature.

questions.explanation: 溶质与溶剂吸引力越弱溶解度越小，故 B 错误。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A solution is prepared by dissolving calcium chloride in water and diluting to 500.0 mL. If this solution contains 44 ppm chloride ions, the concentration of calcium ions is ________ ppm.
questions.explanation: CaCl2 中 Ca2+:Cl-=1:2，故 Ca2+=22 ppm。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Molality is defined as the ________.
questions.explanation: 质量摩尔浓度=mol 溶质/kg 溶剂。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which one of the following concentration units varies with temperature?
questions.explanation: 摩尔浓度随温度变化（体积随温度变化）。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A solution contains 11% by mass of sodium chloride. This means that ________.

options.text: there are 11 g of sodium chloride in in 1.0 mL of this solution
100 g of the solution contains 11 g of sodium chloride
100 mL of the solution contains 11 g of sodium chloride
the density of the solution is 11 g/mL
the molality of the solution is 11

questions.explanation: 11% 质量分数即 100 g 溶液含 11 g NaCl。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A solution contains 15 ppm of benzene. The density of the solution is 1.00 g/mL. This means that ________.

options.text: there are 15 mg of benzene in 1.0 g of this solution
100 g of the solution contains 15 g of benzene
1.0 g of the solution contains 15 × 10-6 g of benzene
1.0 L of the solution contains 15 g of benzene
the solution is 15% by mass of benzene

questions.explanation: 15 ppm=每克溶液含 15×10^-6 g 苯。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The magnitudes of Kf and of Kb depend on the identity of the ________.
questions.explanation: Kf、Kb 取决于溶剂（也随温度略变）。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: As the concentration of a solute in a solution increases, the freezing point of the solution ________ and the vapor pressure of the solution ________.
questions.explanation: 浓度增大，凝固点下降、蒸气压下降。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which of the following liquids will have the highest freezing point?
questions.explanation: 纯水无溶质，凝固点最高。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A 1.35 m aqueous solution of compound X had a boiling point of 101.4 °C. Which one of the following could be compound X? The boiling point elevation constant for water is 0.52 °C/m.
questions.explanation: ΔTb=iKbm，i≈2，故为 KCl。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Of the following, a 0.1 M aqueous solution of ________ will have the lowest freezing point.
questions.explanation: Al(NO3)3 的 i×m=4×0.1=0.4 最大，凝固点最低。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which one of the following solutes has a limiting van't Hoff factor (i) of 3 when dissolved in water?
questions.explanation: Na2SO4 电离出 3 个离子，i=3。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Calculate the vapor pressure of a solution made by dissolving 109 grams of glucose (molar mass = 180.2 g/mol) in 920.0 ml of water at 25 °C. The vapor pressure of pure water at 25 °C is 23.76 mm Hg. Assume the density of the solution is 1.00 g/ml.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The process of a substance sticking to the surface of another is called
questions.explanation: 物质附着于表面称为吸附。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The process of solute particles being surrounded by solvent particles is known as ________.
questions.explanation: 溶质被溶剂包围即溶剂化。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A sample of potassium nitrate (49.0 g) is dissolved in 101 g of water at 100 °C, with precautions taken to avoid evaporation of any water. The solution is cooled to 30.0 °C and no precipitate is observed. This solution is ________. （KNO3 在 30 °C 溶解度约 45 g/100 g 水）
questions.explanation: 冷却到 30 °C 后无沉淀，为过饱和溶液。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A sample of potassium chlorate (15.0 g) is dissolved in 201 g of water at 70 °C, with precautions taken to avoid evaporation of any water. The solution is cooled to 30.0 °C and no precipitate is observed. This solution is ________.
questions.explanation: 15 g KClO3 在 201 g 水中仍未达溶解度，为不饱和。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A solution is prepared by dissolving 15.0 g of NH3 in 250.0 g of water. The density of the resulting solution is 0.974 g/mL. The molarity of NH3 in the solution is ________ M.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The concentration (M) of HCl in a solution prepared by dissolving 5.5 g of HCl in 200 g of C2H6O is ________ M. The density of the solution is 0.79 g/mL.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: What is the molarity of sodium chloride in solution that is 13.0% by mass sodium chloride and that has a density of 1.10 g/mL?

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A burning splint will burn more vigorously in pure oxygen than in air because ________.

options.text: oxygen is a reactant in combustion and concentration of oxygen is higher in pure oxygen than is in air
oxygen is a catalyst for combustion
oxygen is a product of combustion
nitrogen is a product of combustion and the system reaches equilibrium at a lower temperature
nitrogen is a reactant in combustion and its low concentration in pure oxygen catalyzes the combustion

questions.explanation: 纯氧中氧浓度更高，燃烧更旺。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Of the following, all are valid units for a reaction rate except ________.
questions.explanation: mol/L 是浓度单位，不是速率单位。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The rate law of a reaction is rate = k[D][X]. The units of the rate constant are ________.
questions.explanation: 二级反应速率常数单位为 L·mol^-1·s^-1。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The data in the table below were obtained for the reaction: 2 ClO2 (aq) + 2 OH- (aq) → ClO3- (aq) + ClO2- (aq) + H2O (l)（数据：[ClO2]=0.060、0.020、0.020 M；[OH-]=0.030、0.030、0.090 M；初速=0.0248、0.00276、0.00828 M/s）What is the order of the reaction with respect to ClO2?
questions.explanation: ClO2 浓度降为 1/3 时速率降为 1/9，故对 ClO2 为 2 级。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: （沿用第 72 题数据）What is the order of the reaction with respect to OH-?
questions.explanation: OH- 浓度×3 时速率×3，故对 OH- 为 1 级。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: （沿用第 72 题数据）What is the overall order of the reaction?

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: （沿用第 72 题数据）What is the magnitude of the rate constant for the reaction?

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Under constant conditions, the half-life of a first-order reaction ________.

options.text: is the time necessary for the reactant concentration to drop to half its original value
can be calculated from the reaction rate constant
does not depend on the initial reactant concentration
All of the above are correct.

questions.explanation: 一级反应半衰期与初浓度无关且恒定，以上均正确。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The reaction CH3-N≡C → CH3-C≡N is a first-order reaction. At 230.3 °C, k = 6.29 × 10-4 s-1. If [CH3-N≡C] = 1.00 × 10-3 M initially, [CH3-N≡C] is ________ after 1.000 × 10^3 s.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The following reaction is second order in [A] and the rate constant is 0.025 M-1s-1: A → B The concentration of A was 0.65 M at 33 s. The initial concentration of A was ________ M.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The decomposition of N2O5 in solution in carbon tetrachloride proceeds via the reaction 2N2O5 (soln) → 4NO2 (soln) + O2 (soln) The reaction is first order and has a rate constant of 4.82 × 10-3 s-1 at 64 °C. The rate law for the reaction is rate = ________.
questions.explanation: 一级反应速率定律为 rate=k[N2O5]。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: As the temperature of a reaction is increased, the rate of the reaction increases because the ________.

options.text: reactant molecules collide more frequently and with greater energy per collision
reactant molecules collide less frequently and with greater energy per collision
reactant molecules collide more frequently with less energy per collision

questions.explanation: 升温使碰撞更频繁且每次碰撞能量更高。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The rate of a reaction depends on ________.
questions.explanation: 反应速率与碰撞频率、能量、取向都有关。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which energy difference in the energy profile below corresponds to the activation energy for the forward reaction?（能量曲线图）
questions.explanation: 正反应活化能对应能量 x。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: In the Arrhenius equation, k = Ae-Ea/RT ________ is the frequency factor.
questions.explanation: 阿伦尼乌斯方程中 A 为频率因子。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: In general, as activation energy increases, reaction rate ________.

options.text: goes down if the reaction is exothermic
goes down if the reaction is endothermic
stays the same regardless of whether the reaction is exothermic or endothermic
goes down regardless of whether the reaction is exothermic or endothermic

questions.explanation: 活化能越大，反应速率越小。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Which of the following is true?

options.text: If we know that a reaction is an elementary reaction, then we know its rate law.
The rate-determining step of a reaction is the rate of the fastest elementary step of its mechanism.

Since intermediate compounds can be formed, the chemical equations for the elementary reactions in a multistep mechanism do not always have to add to give the chemical equation of the overall process.
In a reaction mechanism, an intermediate is identical to an activated complex.
All of the above statements are true.

questions.explanation: 已知是基元反应即可直接写出其速率定律。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Of the following, ________ will lower the activation energy for a reaction.

options.text: raising the temperature of the reaction
adding a catalyst for the reaction
removing products as the reaction proceeds

questions.explanation: 催化剂能降低活化能。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The rate law of the overall reaction A + B → C is rate = k[A]2. Which of the following will not increase the rate of the reaction?

options.text: increasing the concentration of reactant A
increasing the concentration of reactant B
increasing the temperature of the reaction
adding a catalyst for the reaction
All of these will increase the rate.

questions.explanation: 速率定律不含 B，故增大 B 浓度不加快反应。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: ________ are used in automotive catalytic converters.
questions.explanation: 汽车催化转化器使用多相催化剂。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: Consider the following reaction: A → 2C The average rate of appearance of C is given by Δ[C]/Δt. Comparing the rate of appearance of C and the rate of disappearance of A, we get Δ[C]/Δt = ________ × (-Δ[A]/Δt).

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A flask is charged with 0.124 mol of A and allowed to react to form B according to the reaction A(g) → B(g). The following data are obtained for [A] as the reaction proceeds:（数据：0 s=0.124、10 s=0.110、20 s=0.088、30 s=0.073、40 s=0.054 M）The average rate of disappearance of A between 10 s and 20 s is ________ mol/s.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The average rate of disappearance of A between 20 s and 40 s is ________ mol/s.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The average rate of appearance of B between 20 s and 30 s is ________ mol/s.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The average rate disappearance of A between 20 s and 30 s is ________ mol/s.

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: How many moles of B are present at 10 s?
questions.explanation: 10 s 时 A 减少 0.014 mol，故 B=0.014 mol。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: How many moles of B are present at 30 s?
questions.explanation: 30 s 时 A 减少 0.051 mol，故 B=0.051 mol。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A reaction was found to be second order in carbon monoxide concentration. The rate of the reaction ________ if the [CO] is doubled, with everything else kept the same.

options.text: is reduced by a factor of 2

questions.explanation: 二级反应，浓度×2 则速率×4。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: If the rate law for the reaction 2A + 3B → products is first order in A and second order in B, then the rate law is rate = ________.
questions.explanation: rate=k[A][B]^2。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The overall order of a reaction is 1. The units of the rate constant for the reaction are ________.
questions.explanation: 一级反应速率常数单位为 1/s。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: The kinetics of the reaction below were studied and it was determined that the reaction rate increased by a factor of 9 when the concentration of B was tripled. The reaction is ________ order in B. A + B → P
questions.explanation: 浓度×3 速率×9，故对 B 为二级。

questions.label: chapter3a
questions.stem: A reaction was found to be zero order in A. Increasing the concentration of A by a factor of 3 will cause the reaction rate to ________.

options.text: decrease by a factor of the cube root of 3

questions.explanation: 零级反应速率与浓度无关。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: At equilibrium, ________.

options.text: the rates of the forward and reverse reactions are equal
the rate constants of the forward and reverse reactions are equal
the value of the equilibrium constant is 1
the limiting reagent has been consumed

questions.explanation: 平衡时正、逆反应速率相等，但反应并未停止。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Which one of the following is true concerning the Haber process?

options.text: It is a process used for shifting equilibrium positions to the right for more economical chemical synthesis of a variety of substances.
It is a process used for the synthesis of ammonia.
It is another way of stating Le Châtelier's principle.
It is an industrial synthesis of sodium chloride that was discovered by Karl Haber.
It is a process for the synthesis of elemental chlorine.

questions.explanation: 哈伯法即工业上合成氨的方法。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Which one of the following will change the value of an equilibrium constant?

options.text: adding other substances that do not react with any of the species involved in the equilibrium
varying the initial concentrations of reactants
varying the initial concentrations of products
changing the volume of the reaction vessel

questions.explanation: 平衡常数只随温度改变，与浓度、压强无关。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Which of the following expressions is the correct equilibrium-constant expression for the equilibrium between dinitrogen tetroxide and nitrogen dioxide? N2O4 (g) ⇌ 2NO2 (g)
questions.explanation: Kc = [NO2]^2/[N2O4]，纯固体、纯液体不写入表达式。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The equilibrium-constant expression depends on the ________ of the reaction.

options.text: the quantities of reactants and products initially present

questions.explanation: 平衡常数表达式由反应方程式的计量数决定。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The equilibrium expression for Kp for the reaction below is ________. 2O3 (g) ⇌ 3O2 (g)

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The Keq for the equilibrium below is 7.52 × 10-2 at 480.0 °C. 2Cl2 (g) + 2H2O (g) ⇌ 4HCl (g) + O2 (g) What is the value of Keq at this temperature for the following reaction? 2HCl (g) + ½O2 (g) ⇌ Cl2 (g) + H2O (g)
questions.explanation: 目标反应为原反应逆向并除以 2，故 K' = 1/√K = 1/√0.0752 ≈ 3.65。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Given the following reaction at equilibrium, if Kc = 1.90 × 1019 at 25.0 °C, Kp = ________. H2 (g) + Br2 (g) ⇌ 2 HBr (g)

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Which of the following expressions is the correct equilibrium-constant expression for the reaction below? HF (aq) + H2O (l) ⇌ H3O+ (aq) + F- (aq)
questions.explanation: 水是纯液体不写入，K = [H3O+][F-]/[HF]。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The equilibrium constant for the gas phase reaction N2 (g) + 3H2 (g) ⇌ 2NH3 (g) is Keq = 4.34 × 10-3 at 300 °C. At equilibrium, ________.

options.text: roughly equal amounts of products and reactants are present

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Consider the following equilibrium. 2 SO2 (g) + O2 (g) ⇌ 2 SO3 (g) The equilibrium cannot be established when ________ is/are placed in a 1.0-L container.

options.text: 0.25 mol of SO2 (g) and 0.25 mol of SO3 (g)

questions.explanation: 只放入 SO2 时无法生成 O2，故不能建立该平衡。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: At 400 K, the equilibrium constant for the reaction Br2 (g) + Cl2 (g) ⇌ 2BrCl (g) is Kp = 7.0. A closed vessel at 400 K is charged with 1.00 atm of Br2 (g), 1.00 atm of Cl2 (g), and 2.00 atm of BrCl (g). Use Q to determine which of the statements below is true.

options.text: The equilibrium partial pressures of Br2, Cl2, and BrCl will be the same as the initial values.
The equilibrium partial pressure of Br2 will be greater than 1.00 atm.
At equilibrium, the total pressure in the vessel will be less than the initial total pressure.
The equilibrium partial pressure of BrCl (g) will be greater than 2.00 atm.
The reaction will go to completion since there are equal amounts of Br2 and Cl2.

questions.explanation: Q = 2^2/(1×1) = 4 < Kp = 7，反应向右进行，BrCl 分压增大。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: Q does not change with temperature.
Keq does not change with temperature, whereas Q is temperature dependent.
K does not depend on the concentrations or partial pressures of reaction components.
Q does not depend on the concentrations or partial pressures of reaction components.
Q is the same as Keq when a reaction is at equilibrium.

questions.explanation: K 只与温度有关，不随浓度或分压改变。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: How is the reaction quotient used to determine whether a system is at equilibrium?

options.text: The reaction quotient must be satisfied for equilibrium to be achieved.
At equilibrium, the reaction quotient is undefined.
The reaction is at equilibrium when Q < Keq.
The reaction is at equilibrium when Q > Keq.
The reaction is at equilibrium when Q = Keq.

questions.explanation: Q = K 时体系处于平衡。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Of the following equilibria, only ________ will shift to the right in response to a decrease in volume.
questions.explanation: 减小体积（增大压强）时平衡向气体分子数少的一侧移动；C 为 4→2，正向移动。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Consider the following reaction at equilibrium: 2NH3 (g) ⇌ N2 (g) + 3H2 (g) Le Châtelier's principle predicts that the moles of H2 in the reaction container will increase with ________.

options.text: some removal of NH3 from the reaction vessel (V and T constant)
a decrease in the total pressure (T constant)
addition of some N2 to the reaction vessel (V and T constant)
a decrease in the total volume of the reaction vessel (T constant)
an increase in total pressure by the addition of helium gas (V and T constant)

questions.explanation: 降低总压使平衡向气体分子数多的一侧（右）移动，H2 增多。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The effect of a catalyst on an equilibrium is to ________.

options.text: increase the rate of the forward reaction only
increase the equilibrium constant so that products are favored
increase the rate at which equilibrium is achieved without changing the composition of the equilibrium mixture
shift the equilibrium to the right

questions.explanation: 催化剂只加快达到平衡，不改变平衡组成与 K。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The value of Keq for the equilibrium H2 (g) + I2 (g) ⇌ 2HI (g) is 794 at 25 °C. What is the value of Keq for the equilibrium below? ½H2 (g) + ½I2 (g) ⇌ HI (g)
questions.explanation: 方程式系数减半，K' = √794 ≈ 28。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The value of Keq for the equilibrium CO2 (g) + 2H2 (g) ⇌ CH3OH (g) is 14.5 at 483 °C. What is the value of Keq for the equilibrium below? ½CO2 (g) + H2 (g) ⇌ ½CH3OH (g)

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: A reaction vessel is charged with hydrogen iodide, which partially decomposes to molecular hydrogen and iodine: 2HI (g) ⇌ H2(g) + I2(g) When the system comes to equilibrium at 425 °C, PHI = 0.708 atm, and PH2 = PI2 = 0.0960 atm. The value of Kp at this temperature is ________.

options.text: Kp cannot be calculated for this gas reaction when the volume of the reaction vessel is not given.

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Given the following reaction: CO (g) + 2 H2(g) ⇌ CH3OH (g) In an experiment, 0.42 mol of CO and 0.42 mol of H2 were placed in a 1.00-L reaction vessel. At equilibrium, there were 0.29 mol of CO remaining. Keq at the temperature of the experiment is ________.

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: A sealed 1.0 L flask is charged with 0.500 mol of I2 and 0.500 mol of Br2. An equilibrium reaction ensues: I2 (g) + Br2 (g) ⇌ 2IBr (g) When the container contents achieve equilibrium, the flask contains 0.84 mol of IBr. The value of Keq is ________.

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: At 200 °C, the equilibrium constant (Kp) for the reaction below is 2.40 × 103. 2NO (g) ⇌ N2 (g) + O2 (g) A closed vessel is charged with 36.1 atm of NO. At equilibrium, the partial pressure of O2 is ________ atm.

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: According to the Arrhenius concept, an acid is a substance that ________.

options.text: is capable of donating one or more H+
causes an increase in the concentration of H+ in aqueous solutions
can accept a pair of electrons to form a coordinate covalent bond
reacts with the solvent to form the cation formed by autoionization of that solvent

questions.explanation: 阿伦尼乌斯酸能使水溶液中 H+ 浓度增大。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: A Br∅nsted-Lowry base is defined as a substance that ________.
questions.explanation: 布朗斯特-劳里碱是质子接受体。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The molar concentration of hydronium ion in pure water at 25 °C is ________.

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The hydride ion, H-, is a stronger base than the hydroxide ion, OH-. The product(s) of the reaction of hydride ion with water is/are ________.
questions.explanation: H- 是强碱，夺取水中的 H 生成 H2 和 OH-。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Of the following acids, ________ is a strong acid.
questions.explanation: 硝酸是强酸。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Of the following, ________ is a weak acid.
questions.explanation: HF 是弱酸。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Of the acids in the table below, ________ is the strongest acid. (Ka: HOAc 1.8 × 10-5; HCHO2 1.8 × 10-4; HClO 3.0 × 10-8; HF 6.8 × 10-4)
questions.explanation: Ka 越大酸性越强，HF 的 Ka = 6.8×10^-4 最大。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: The Ka of hypochlorous acid (HClO) is 3.0 × 10-8 at 25 °C. What is the percent ionization of hypochlorous acid in a 0.015 M aqueous solution of HClO at 25 °C?

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Classify the following compounds as weak acids (W) or strong acids (S): benzoic acid nitric acid acetic acid
questions.explanation: 苯甲酸弱、硝酸强、乙酸弱，故为 W S W。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Classify the following compounds as weak acids (W) or strong acids (S): hypochlorous acid perchloric acid chloric acid
questions.explanation: HClO 弱、HClO4 强、HClO3 强，故为 W S S。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Ammonia is a ________.
questions.explanation: 氨是弱碱。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: HA is a weak acid. Which equilibrium corresponds to the equilibrium constant Kb for A-?
questions.explanation: Kb 对应 A- 与水生成 HA 和 OH- 的平衡。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Classify the following compounds as weak bases (W) or strong bases (S): ammonia fluoride ion sodium hydroxide
questions.explanation: 氨弱碱、F- 弱碱、NaOH 强碱，故为 W W S。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Using the data in the table, which of the conjugate bases below is the strongest base? (Ka: HOAc 1.8 × 10-5; HC7H5O2 6.3 × 10-5; HNO2 4.5 × 10-4; HF 6.8 × 10-4)
questions.explanation: 酸越弱其共轭碱越强；HOAc 的 Ka 最小，OAc- 最强。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Using the data in the table, which of the conjugate bases below is the strongest base? (Ka: HOAc 1.8 × 10-5; HCHO2 1.8 × 10-4; HClO 3.0 × 10-8; HF 6.8 × 10-4)
questions.explanation: HClO 的 Ka 最小，其共轭碱 ClO- 最强。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Using the data in the table, which of the conjugate acids below is the strongest acid? (Kb: ClO- 3.3 × 10-7; CO3^2- 1.8 × 10-4; HS- 1.8 × 10-7; NH2CH3 4.4 × 10-4)
questions.explanation: 碱越强其共轭酸越强；甲胺 Kb 最大，CH3NH3+ 最强。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Using the data in the table, which of the conjugate acids below is the weakest acid? (Kb: NH3 1.8 × 10-5; C5H5N 1.7 × 10-9; H2NOH 1.1 × 10-8; NH2CH3 4.4 × 10-4)
questions.explanation: 吡啶 Kb 最小，其共轭酸 C5H5NH+ 最弱。

questions.label: chapter3b
questions.stem: Which of the following ions will act as a weak base in water?

options.text: None of the above will act as a weak base in water.

questions.explanation: 第一过渡系以 +2、+3 氧化态最常见。
